title: Hold motor vehicle race meetings only on a licensed ground
what: Hold, promote or organise motor vehicle race meetings only on a licensed motor vehicle racing ground, within its licence.

sources.title: Motor Vehicle Sports (Public Safety) Act 1985 (NSW)
sources.publisher: NSW Legislation (via the Open Australian Legal Corpus)
sources.quote: A meeting for motor vehicle racing shall not be held except— (a) on a motor vehicle racing ground in respect of which a licence is in force, and (b) in accordance with the authority conferred by the licence and the conditions to which the licence is subject

administration.who: Minister administering the Motor Vehicle Sports (Public Safety) Act 1985 (NSW)

sources.title: Motor Vehicle Sports (Public Safety) Act 1985 (NSW)
sources.publisher: NSW Legislation (via the Open Australian Legal Corpus)
sources.locator: s 4, words naming the body (found 18 Nov 2026)
sources.quote: the Minister may issue a licence to the applicant authorising the holding on that land of meetings for motor vehicle racing at which such types of motor vehicles as may be specified in the licence (or, where the licence so specifies, any type of motor vehicle) may compete.
